classification.difficultyReason: Infer missing boundary lengths, combine algebraic perimeter terms and split an L-shaped region into rectangles.

spec.description: An orthogonal L-shaped region with four supplied dimensions and four right-angle markers. The lower horizontal span comprises the middle 2x segment and upper x segment. Shading identifies the region explicitly named in both parts.
spec.mathematics: The bottom length is 3x cm and the right height is 6 cm. The lower rectangle is 3x cm by 3 cm; the upper-right rectangle is x cm by 3 cm. Only supplied measurements appear in the question diagram.
spec.answerVisibility: All source givens remain visible; inferred lengths, area partitions and answers are absent.

children.label: a
children.prompt: the perimeter of the shaded region

answer.short:
$(6x+12)\text{ cm}$

Add all six boundary lengths.
answer.worked:
The bottom length is $2x+x=3x$ cm. The right-hand height is $3+3=6$ cm.

$$\begin{align*}P&=3x+6+x+3+2x+3\\P&=(6x+12)\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: the area of the shaded region

answer.short:
$12x\text{ cm}^2$

Split the region into two rectangles and add their areas.
answer.worked:
Split horizontally from the inward corner to the right edge. The lower rectangle measures $3x$ cm by $3$ cm; the upper rectangle measures $x$ cm by $3$ cm.

$$\begin{align*}A&=3x\times3+x\times3\\A&=9x+3x\\A&=12x\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$
